title: Geo-affinity precedence matrix and operator override UI for hosted endpoints
creator: Priya Natarajan
description:
Problem: Customers need a predictable, explainable way to control where hosted API requests are served, but current residency controls are coarse (tenant-level pins) and lack a documented precedence model. Operators also need a safe override path for transient capacity failures or emergency migrations without breaking audit trails.

Goal: Ship an operator-facing UI and API that lets tenants and Redwood operators: 1) view the effective geo-affinity decision for an endpoint (computed precedence matrix across tenant policy, route hints, region availability, and SLA tier), 2) apply a temporary operator override with TTL and rationale, and 3) export an auditable evidence bundle that captures the inputs, timeline, and fallback actions taken.

Scope: Hosted API only. This ticket covers product requirements, acceptance criteria, and design alignment for the operator override flow and a read-only precedence visualization in the Console. Implementation (ENG) and telemetry (SRE) tickets will be created as dependencies.

Non-goals: Changing runtime routing logic or committed placement guarantees for Dedicated/Private. Not building tenant self-serve enforcement for on-prem models (separate project).
acceptance_criteria: Console shows a read-only Geo-Affinity Precedence view for each hosted endpoint that lists ordered inputs (tenant preference, route hint, region capacity, SLA tier) and the computed effective region
Operators can create a temporary 'Override' for an endpoint via UI and API; override requires a TTL (1h-30d), a justification, and an audit entry
All override and precedence decisions are captured in an evidence bundle export (JSON + signed manifest) containing input policies, decision timestamp, operator identity, and rollback history
Exported evidence bundle can be downloaded from Console and is stored in the tenant's audit log with an immutable reference
UX flows reviewed and approved by Design, PM, and Security; prototype usability session (3 customers) completed and feedback addressed
Telemetry emitted for precedence decisions, overrides, and fallback events; dashboards show override frequency and customer-impacting fallbacks
tasks: PM: finalize precedence matrix and interaction spec
Design: high-fidelity Console mockups for precedence view and override modal
ENG: define API contract for override create/delete and precedence read
SRE: design audit evidence bundle schema and retention plan
Security: review and sign-off on operator auth and auditability
Docs: draft admin docs and runbook for emergency override procedures
